hey, we need a classic three-tier web application on virtual machines on Azure, several hundred thousand daily active users. running it in westeurope. we want a PostgreSQL database, asynchronous processing through a queue. it handles sensitive customer data so please keep it locked down. thanks!

What's a good AWS and Azure architecture for a multi-cloud DR setup: run on AWS, fail over to Azure? We expect over 500,000 users and will run in ap-southeast-1 (AWS) and westus2 (Azure). It needs a serverless NoSQL data store, a Redis cache. It has to meet compliance requirements.

Design a service-per-domain architecture on AWS containers for a booking workload on AWS, deployed in ap-south-1. Expected load: around 50,000 daily active users. It needs PostgreSQL, caching for hot reads, a queue for background jobs. We handle sensitive customer data and expect an audit, so lock it down. It must be highly available across two availability zones, follow the AWS Well-Architected Framework and be ready to deploy without further changes.

Design an active-active web application spread across AWS and Azure for a booking workload on AWS and Azure, deployed in eu-central-1 (AWS) and westeurope (Azure). Expected load: about 250,000 users. It needs a NoSQL database, an in-memory cache layer. Compliance matters here: encryption, private networking and full monitoring are required. It must be highly available across two availability zones, follow the AWS and Azure Well-Architected Framework and be ready to deploy without further changes.
